note.p: This name appears relatively late in the diary – from 1825 until 1834 with over 110 mentions. There is no Hodget in the DNB, nor in the three biographies. There is nothing extant in the letters in the Abinger collection, although Godwin does note writing to him. There’s also no specific circle that Hodgets appears with – he generally sups or dines with Godwin alone, or Godwin sups at his. At an ‘au soir’ in 1827, Hodgets appears with Bowrings, Buckingham, J Hume, M Hill, Harwood, Henning, R T, miss Tooke. He appears with Bowring and Booth on separate occasions the following year, and also with ‘5 do’s’ indicating his family. There are two Miss Hodgets in 1826, six Mrs Hodgets between 1826 and 1830, and four S Hodgets in 1830. These remain uncoded.
